summary: Four real XCUITest UI tests (no-project, initial-loading via deterministic FIFO gate, clean-working-tree, git-failure) each assert their unique state-specific text and explicitly assert absence of the 'Files' stat label that only appears in the populated-summary rendering (confirmed by the sibling populated-state test), genuinely rejecting the counterexample of any state leaking into a populated status summary; loading state is gated by a FIFO rather than a timing hack, avoiding flakiness.
